::: {.page-intro}
<h3 style="margin-top:0;">week1_reaction_times_final.csv</h3>
<p>The <strong>cleaned</strong> version — the raw data above, with the recommended treatment from the <a href="week1-outliers-addendum.html" style="color:#457b9d;">Week 1 outliers addendum</a> applied: one wildly extreme trial dropped (a measurement error), the flagged-but-real trials at positions 3–10 dropped with a note (distraction, not the ability being measured), the flagged trials at positions 1–2 kept (a genuine warm-up effect). This is the dataset Week 2 onward is built on.</p>

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  document.querySelectorAll(".data-download-btn").forEach(function (btn) {
    var url = btn.getAttribute("data-url");
    var filename = btn.getAttribute("data-filename");
    var status = btn.parentElement.nextElementSibling;
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      status.textContent = "Downloading…";
      fetch(url)
        .then(function (resp) {
          if (!resp.ok) { throw new Error("HTTP " + resp.status); }
          return resp.blob();
        })
        .then(function (blob) {
          var objUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          var a = document.createElement("a");
          a.href = objUrl;
          a.download = filename;
          document.body.appendChild(a);
          a.click();
          a.remove();
          URL.revokeObjectURL(objUrl);
          status.textContent = "Downloaded — check your Downloads folder.";
        })
        .catch(function () {
          status.textContent = "Something went wrong — use the link below instead.";
        });
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```
